content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 already delivers our preferred ASSIGN position on all four elements:

| Playbook element | Where satisfied |
|---|---|
| Customer may assign to Affiliate/successor without consent | 24.1 (notice only) |
| Vendor may not assign without our consent, reasonableness-qualified | 24.2 |
| Never to a Customer competitor | 24.2 (absolute bar) |
| No Vendor right on our change of control | 24.4 (no terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate, or reduce) |

Both planner concerns resolve in our favor: 24.3's residual consent requirement is prefaced "For other assignments," so it cannot be read to override the 24.1 carve-out, and 13.3 correctly ties licence portability to "an assignment permitted by Section 24" so a permitted successor inherits the licence. 24.2 is also usefully broad in capturing delegation of material performance and Vendor-side change of control, not just formal assignment.

One drafting observation for the negotiation log, not worth a redline: 24.1 requires "prompt written notice" without a deadline, and Section 29.2 says email alone is insufficient for assignment notices absent acknowledgment. That is a minor administrative point only and does not condition the assignment right itself, so I did not open it.
